critical_code_review_comments: MINOR (perf): competitive_routes.py _generate_competitive_paper() calls _retrieve_anchors() THREE times at write time (once before LLM, then twice again inside the $set for rag_anchors_used + rag_difficulty_distribution). Trivially reuse the original `anchors` and `rag_dist` to avoid 2 extra Mongo+TF-IDF passes per generated paper.

MINOR (bug surface): rag-preview anchors include the raw `_score` float — exposing internal scoring is fine for the teacher UI but consider rounding to 3 decimals to avoid floats like 0.4274938... leaking through.

MINOR (correctness): _ingest_past_paper() caps to first 6 chunks of 6000 chars (≈36KB of text). For long JEE/NEET papers this silently drops later questions. Consider parametrizing or surfacing a warning in past_paper.error when chunks were truncated.

MINOR (typo): CompetitiveExams.jsx imports `Books` from @phosphor-icons/react — the icon is named `Books` in Phosphor v2+; verify it isn't `BookOpen`/`BooksLight` in your installed version (currently rendering fine, just flag if upgrade breaks).
INFO: rag.py top_k_similar() correctly vectorizes topic+text and falls back to lexical overlap on tiny corpora — solid MVP.
INFO: 600 dpi math render is confirmed visually crisp + PDF generation under 5s for a 6-question paper. No memory blowup observed.
INFO: All routes properly guarded — student 403 on POST /api/competitive-exams, POST /papers/upload, GET /rag-preview, POST /generate-paper. GET list correctly filters by is_shared for students.
